mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days. Falsifiable: if FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% in 60% of instances but SPX 20d returns negative in >60% of those periods (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days. failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 5d returns positive in >60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
